timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹420.18 Cr (+4.9% YoY), net profit ₹1.14 Cr (against a loss of ₹11.94 Cr a year earlier).
Prataap Snacks reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹420.2 crore and annual revenue of ₹1,725 crore, recommending a dividend of ₹0.50 per share.

Authum Investment & Infrastructure disclosed under SAST Regulation 31(4) that 4,60,000 Prataap Snacks shares (1.92% of capital) of its 44% promoter holding were encumbered by a margin pledge during FY26.
Prataap Snacks received stock exchanges' no-objection letters for the re-classification of six promoter group members to public.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹543.93 Cr, net loss ₹2.75 Cr.
Prataap Snacks reported record Q2FY27 revenue of ₹541 Cr but a net loss of ₹2.5 Cr due to severe input cost inflation.
